artist.tagline: Uganda’s Premier DJ, Mixing Prodigy & Creative Architect
artist.bio: DJ EMMA PRO is a Ugandan DJ and creative professional from Serere District in the Teso Region of Eastern Uganda, based in Kampala. He is passionate about music entertainment, DJ mixing, graphic design, creative branding and professional DJ drops. Known as THE WAKANDA BOSS, DJ EMMA PRO represents the Ugandan entertainment scene through music, creativity and energetic mixes.
artist.origin: Serere District, Teso Region, Eastern Uganda
